                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Tappka\\n\\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\\n\\n## Features\\n\\n- [ ] Authentication\\n- [ ] Room booking\\n- [ ] Essay Bank\\n\\n# Links\\n\\n## Publicly available\\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\\n\\n## Locally available when running the project\\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\\n\\n## Other links\\n\\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\\n\\n# Language\\n\\n [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 2943,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Tappka Authentication System Design\\n\\n**Date:** 2026-01-25  \\n**Status:** Approved  \\n**Author:** Claude + User collaboration\\n\\n## Overview\\n\\nTappka is a student portal for Tiimiakatemia Prague (TAP) students. This design covers the authentication and verification system that allows students, coaches, and admins to access the platform.\\n\\n## User Roles\\n\\n| Role | Description | Team Required |\\n|------|-------------|---------------|\\n| Student | Regular TAP student | Yes |\\n| Team Leader | Leads a team company (tymova firma) | Yes |\\n| Coach | Program coach/mentor | No |\\n| Admin | Full system access, user management | No |\\n\\n## Authentication Flow\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐\\n│   Landing    │     │  Register    │     │    Login     │\\n│   Page (/)   │────▶│  /auth/      │────▶│   Success    │\\n│              │     │  sign-up     │     │              │\\n└──────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └──────┬────── [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3092,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"                     │   /verify    │            │         │  /dashboard  │\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 3202,

                }
              ]

Fixed the layout issues after moving the dashboard from `/dashboard` to `/`. Changes:

## Fixed Issues:

1. **Sidebar pathname checks**: Updated from relative to absolute paths:
   - Changed `pathname.startsWith("reservations")` to `pathname.startsWith("/reservations")`
   - Fixed submenu active state checks to use absolute paths (`/reservations` and `/reservations/settings`)

2. **Sidebar navigation URLs**: Changed all relative URLs to absolute:
   - `"reservations"` → `"/reservations"`
   - `"essays"` → `"/essays"`
   - `"meetings"` → `"/meetings"`
   - `"library"` → `"/library"`
   - `"settings"` → `"/settings"`
   - `"help"` → `"/help"`
   - Dashboard already had `"/"` ✓

3. **Dashboard layout breadcrumb**: Updated the old `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` breadcrumb link from `/dashboard` to `/`

Navigation now works correctly from the root route `/`. The sidebar active states and links use absolute paths, so they work regardless of the current route.

        "contents": "- **Alternativní místnosti**: Nabídka volných místností v požadovaný čas\n- **Analytika**: Statistiky vytíženosti, počet rezervací na uživatele\n\n### Coach dashboard\n- Nastavení rozvrhu TS pro místnosti\n- Výběr: místnost, tým, den, čas\n- Platnost: semestr\n- **Days of Joy**: Speciální týden bez TS (1x za semestr) - místnosti volné\n- **Volno/Prázdniny**: Období bez TS (svátky, vánoce, etc.) - místnosti volné\n\n---\n\n## URL struktura\n\n- NFC: &#96;https://tiimi.cz/rezervace/[kod]&#96; (např. &#96;/rezervace/d126&#96;)\n- QR short: &#96;https://tiimi.cz/r/[kod]&#96; → redirect na hlavní\n\n---\n\n## Obrazovky\n\n### 1. Hlavní stránka (&#96;reservations&#96;)\n- Seznam místností s dostupností (\"volná od X\")\n- Barevné kódování stavu\n- Sekce \"Moje rezervace\"\n- Filtrování\n\n### 2. Detail místnosti (&#96;reservations/[kod]&#96;)\n- Kalendář s rezervacemi\n- Formulář pro rezervaci (čas, důvod, počet osob, cowork toggle)\n- Zobrazení TS\n- Report button\n- Alternativní místnosti\n\n### 3. Coach nastavení (&#96;reservations/settings&#96;)\n- Pouze pro role coach/admin\n- Nastavení opakovaných TS",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Public NFC/QR entry point for room reservations\n * - If user is logged in, redirects to dashboard version\n * - If not logged in, shows room status and login prompt\n */\nexport default async function RezerevacePage({ params }: RezervecePageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is logged in\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // If logged in, redirect to dashboard version\n  if (user) {\n    redirect(&#96;reservations/${code}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Fetch current reservation and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  const [currentResResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .lte(\"start_time\", now)\n      .gt(\"end_time\", now)\n      .single(),\n\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n  ]);\n\n  const currentReservation = currentResResult.data as Reservation | null;\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const isLocked = issues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n\n  // Determine status\n  const isOccupied = currentReservation !== null;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen bg-background flex items-center justify-center p-4\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "/**\n * Room detail page with calendar and reservation form\n */\nexport default async function RoomDetailPage({ params }: RoomDetailPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Fetch data in parallel\n  // Include past 7 days for navigation + future 14 days\n  const today = new Date();\n  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\n\n  const oneWeekAgo = new Date(today);\n  oneWeekAgo.setDate(oneWeekAgo.getDate() - 7);\n\n  const twoWeeksLater = new Date(today);\n  twoWeeksLater.setDate(twoWeeksLater.getDate() + 14);\n\n  const oneWeekAgoStr = oneWeekAgo.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n  const twoWeeksLaterStr = twoWeeksLater.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n\n  const [reservationsResult, issuesResult, alternativeRoomsResult, breaksResult] = await \n;\n}",

        "contents": "# Kontext - Rezervace místností\n\n**Datum zahájení:** 2026-01-29  \n**Status:** Plánování  \n**Spolupráce:** Onda + Claude\n\n---\n\n## O čem je tento dokument\n\nTento soubor slouží jako centrální místo pro:\n- Poznámky a nápady k rezervačnímu systému\n- Rozhodnutí která jsme udělali a proč\n- Kontext pro pokračování práce\n- Odkazy na relevantní soubory a zdroje\n\n---\n\n## Analýza existujícího kódu\n\n### Architektura aplikace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ntappka/\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router\n│   ├── page.tsx           # Landing + Login\n│   ├── layout.tsx         # Root layout (fonty, theme)\n│   ├── globals.css        # TAP branding, barvy\n│   ├── auth/              # Auth stránky\n│   │   ├── sign-up/\n│   │   ├── forgot-password/\n│   │   └── update-password/\n│   ├── verify/            # Ověření školního emailu\n│   ├── dashboard/         # Chráněná sekce\n│   │   ├── layout.tsx     # Sidebar + header\n│   │   └── page.tsx       # Dashboard home\n│   └── api/verify/        # API routes pro verifikaci\n├── components/            # React komponenty\n│   ├── ui/               # shadcn/ui komponenty\n│   ├── app-sidebar.tsx   # Hlavní navigace\n│   ├── login-form.tsx\n│   ├── sign-up-form.tsx\n│   ├── verify-form.tsx\n│   └── ...\n├── lib/\n│   ├── supabase/         # Supabase klienti\n│   │   ├── client.ts     # Browser client\n│   │   └── server.ts     # Server client\n│   └── utils.ts          # Utility funkce (cn)\n└── supabase/\n    ├── config.toml       # Lokální Supabase konfig\n    └── migrations/       # SQL migrace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Klíčové vzory v kódu\n\n#### 1. Server vs Client komponenty\n- **Server by default** - stránky jsou RSC\n- **\"use client\"** jen kde je potřeba (formuláře, interaktivita)\n- Příklad: &#96;page.tsx&#96; je server, &#96;login-form.tsx&#96; je client",

        "contents": "- 6-digit code input (individual boxes)\n- \"Overit\" button\n- \"Neprisel kod? Poslat znovu\" link with cooldown\n\n## Route Structure\n\n### Public Routes (no auth required)\n- &#96;/&#96; - Landing page (redirects if logged in)\n- &#96;/auth/sign-up&#96; - Registration\n- &#96;/auth/forgot-password&#96; - Password reset request\n- &#96;/auth/update-password&#96; - Set new password\n\n### Semi-Protected Routes (auth required, verification optional)\n- &#96;/verify&#96; - School email verification\n\n### Protected Routes (auth + verification required)\n- &#96;/&#96; - Main dashboard\n- &#96;/admin/*&#96; - Admin-only pages\n\n## Internationalization (i18n)\n\nSupport for Czech (default) and English:\n- Auto-detect browser language\n- Manual toggle available\n- Store preference in user profile (locale field)\n\n## API Endpoints\n\n### &#96;POST /api/verify/send-code&#96;\nSend verification code to school email.\n\n**Request:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"school_email\": \"jan.novak@pef.czu.cz\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"message\": \"Code sent\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Errors:**\n- 400: Email not in pre-registered list\n- 400: Email already claimed\n- 429: Too many requests (rate limit)\n\n### &#96;POST /api/verify/check-code&#96;\nValidate verification code.\n\n**Request:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"school_email\": \"jan.novak@pef.czu.cz\",\n  \"code\": \"123456\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"verified\": true\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Errors:**\n- 400: Invalid code\n- 400: Code expired\n- 400: Too many attempts\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n1. **Rate limiting** - Max 3 code requests per hour per user\n2. **Code expiration** - Codes expire after 15 minutes\n3. **Attempt limiting** - Max 5 failed attempts per code\n4. **Email validation** - Only pre-registered school emails accepted\n5. **RLS policies** - Row-level security on all tables\n\n## Out of Scope (Future)\n\n- Admin Excel import UI\n- Room reservation system\n- Essay storage\n- Meeting management\n- Admin dashboard for user management",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport {\n  OPERATING_HOURS,\n  MAX_ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS,\n  type CreateReservationInput,\n} from \"@/lib/reservations/types\";\nimport { isRoomAvailableOnDay } from \"@/lib/reservations/utils\";\nimport { getCurrentUserProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * GET /api/reservations\n * Fetch reservations with optional filters\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n    const roomId = searchParams.get(\"room_id\");\n    const startDate = searchParams.get(\"start_date\");\n    const endDate = searchParams.get(\"end_date\");\n    const userId = searchParams.get(\"user_id\");\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .order(\"start_time\");\n\n    if (roomId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"room_id\", roomId);\n    }\n\n    if (startDate) {\n      query = query.gte(\"end_time\", startDate);\n    }\n\n    if (endDate) {\n      query = query.lte(\"start_time\", endDate);\n    }\n\n    if (userId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"user_id\", userId);\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await query;\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching reservations:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst rezervace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * POST /api/reservations\n * Create a new reservation\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/reservations/[id]\n * Get a single reservation\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try {\n    const { id } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { data: reservation, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"id\", id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (error || !reservation) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data: reservation });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations/[id] error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * PATCH /api/reservations/[id]\n * Update a reservation\n */\nexport async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/reservations/page.tsx",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Main reservations page showing all rooms and user's reservations\n */\nexport default async function ReservationsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Fetch rooms with current reservations and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  const [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // All rooms\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Current and upcoming reservations for today\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .lte(\"start_time\", new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n\n    // Open issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"room_id, issue_type\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n\n    // User's own reservations\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user?.id ?? \"\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(10),\n\n    // Get reservation IDs user has joined\n    supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"reservation_id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user?.id ?? \"\"),\n\n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles!reservations_user_id_fkey(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"is_cowork_open\", true)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(50), // Increased limit to catch both joined and available\n  ]);\n\n  // Process rooms with status\n  const rooms = roomsResult.data || [];\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; now) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nelze rezervovat v minulosti\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check: within booking window (2 weeks)\n    const maxDate = new Date();\n    maxDate.setDate(maxDate.getDate() + MAX_ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS);\n    if (startDate &gt;         "contents": "└─ e2e/                       # End-to-end tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Directory Conventions\n\n- Use **kebab-case** for folders and files\n- Co-locate tests next to source: &#96;*.test.ts(x)&#96;\n- Export from &#96;index.ts&#96; barrels only when it helps DX without circular deps\n\n## Next.js App Router Rules\n\n### Server vs Client Components\n\n- **Default to RSC** (no \"use client\"). Use client components only for:\n  - Interactivity (event handlers)\n  - Browser APIs (localStorage, window, etc.)\n  - Third-party libraries requiring client-side initialization\n\n### Server Boundaries\n\n- Keep data access in server context (RSC, server actions, API routes)\n- API routes in &#96;app/api&#96; are for external webhooks only\n- Use internal APIs (tRPC, server actions) for app-to-app communication\n\n### Performance &amp; UX\n\n- Use &#96;&lt;Suspense&gt;&#96; for async UI; provide skeletons\n- Implement proper loading and error boundaries\n- Use Next.js caching (&#96;revalidateTag&#96;, &#96;revalidatePath&#96;) appropriately\n- Prefer Edge runtime for simple operations, Node for complex ones\n\n### Accessibility\n\n- All interactive elements must have proper roles and labels\n- Ensure keyboard navigation support\n- Provide ARIA attributes where needed\n- Test with screen readers\n\n## API Architecture\n\n### Internal APIs (tRPC Recommended)\n\n- Organize by feature domains\n- Use Zod for input validation\n- Implement proper error handling with custom error classes\n- Keep business logic server-side (no JSX in API layer)\n- Write integration tests with mocked external services\n- **Router logic should be application code only** - delegate to business logic services\n- **Use only protected procedures** for all endpoints\n- **Split procedures and routers** into separate files for better organization\n\n### Application Logic vs Business Logic\n\n**Application Logic** (in tRPC procedures):\n- Input validation and sanitization\n- Authentication and authorization checks\n- Request/response formatting\n- Error handling and mapping\n- Delegation to business logic services\n- Logging and observability",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
